theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트
theme_rankings.why_now: AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출. 미국 AI 주식 테마와 동행 흐름.
theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.
theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

top_news.title: GPIF Didn’t Discuss Portfolio Allocation, Damping Speculation
top_news.summary: Japan’s Government Pension Investment Fund didn’t discuss portfolio allocation at a meeting last month, damping speculation that the $2 trillion fund will respond to calls from Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s administration to increase its purchases of assets in Japan.

top_news.title: Philippines’ Inflation Heats Up for First Time in Five Months
top_news.summary: Philippine inflation gained pace again in September, ending four months of deceleration as fuel prices surged.

top_news.title: S&P 500 Closes In on Record High as Tech Rallies: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian shares rose after a tech-led rally sent the Nasdaq 100 Index to a record as equity investors shrugged off concerns about elevated oil prices and bond yields holding at multi-decade highs.

top_news.title: New World Launches Exchange Offer for Nearly $1 Billion of Bonds
top_news.summary: New World Development Co. kicked off an exchange offer for about $991 million of outstanding dollar notes, in the latest efforts by the stressed Hong Kong developer to extend maturities and shore up liquidity.

top_news.title: Nidec Scandal Sends Bonds to Bottom in Test for New President
top_news.summary: Scandal-tainted Nidec Corp., which grew from a Kyoto startup into the world’s largest manufacturer of precision motors, has fallen to the bottom rank of the yen debt market by one measure, leaving its new president with a challenge to restore investor confidence.

top_news.title: Japan's Takaichi Pitches Food Tax Cut, Investment Plan
top_news.summary: Bloomberg's Sakura Murakami breaks down Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's address to parliament outlining a temporary tax relief on food combined with targeted measures to maintain market discipline. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: LA Schools Face High Fiscal Solvency Risk, State Report Says
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Unified School District has a high fiscal solvency risk level as its yearslong enrollment decline continues, according to a new analysis from California officials.

top_news.title: Higher Bond Yields Will Pressure Australia Budget, Chalmers Says
top_news.summary: Higher global bond yields will put pressure on the Australian budget as debt refinancing costs rise, according to Australian Treasurer Jim Chalmers. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Gold Steadies as Stronger Dollar and Yields Weigh on Rate Path
top_news.summary: Gold was steady as traders weighed the impact of a stronger dollar and higher Treasury yields on the Federal Reserve’s path for interest rates.

top_news.title: A Trader’s Guide to Navigating Malaysia’s 2027 Budget Plan
top_news.summary: Malaysia’s consumer and construction stocks may emerge as beneficiaries of next year’s spending plan as Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim seeks to ease living costs while maintaining fiscal prudence.
